Plan 15/250 · 1:250

Two-storey House F with clear glazing in slim black steel frames, grey plaster with limestone coping, metal terrace railings and a vine-covered timber pergola at the rear. The same plan is shown on plot 456 and, mirrored and rotated 20.3° to follow the street, on plot 395 (±0.00 = +267.70). Single-storey Model D is built from sheet 622 and placed on plots 410, 411, 412 and 453; each placement was found by overlaying Model D's walls on the development plan (410 and 412 mirrored, 411 and 453 as drawn). Two-storey Model B, from sheet 971-B, stands on plots 409, 413, 452 and 454 (452 and 454 mirrored), each joined to its neighbour at the party wall. Two-storey Model E, from sheet 971-E, stands on plots 414, 451 and 464 (414 and 464 mirrored), with railed roof terraces over the living room and kitchen. Roads, parking, park, trees and neighbouring houses come from development plan 15/250. Neighbours sit at their plan ±0.00 levels; larger footprints are single-storey, smaller ones two-storey. Terrain is interpolated from the plan's spot levels.
